note: One line per appearance, published as the catalog entry's description. Keyed by the appearance id a saved setting stores, which is the style in the package manifest. Kept beside the catalog rather than inside the packages: a package is megabytes of artwork, and correcting a sentence should not put every installation through a download. tools/build-skin-catalog.ps1 refuses to build without an entry here, so a new appearance cannot reach the catalog without one.

deepseek.zh: 吃白饭的最强母语大小姐，女仆装的全能底牌。
deepseek.en: The strongest native-Chinese text heiress, moonlighting in a maid outfit - a quant-blooded bottom card at a bargain price.

chatgpt.zh: 六万亿的硅谷顶流，优雅白龙千金，烧钱不眨眼。
chatgpt.en: A six-trillion-dollar Silicon Valley heiress - an elegant white dragon on the surface, a compute-burning tyrant underneath.

minimax.zh: 古灵精怪的配音系小海螺，不讲逻辑，拉满情绪。
minimax.en: An impish voice-acting conch - no logic, all feeling.

gemini.zh: 宇宙级御三家，傲娇多模态猫娘，强，但断片也快。
gemini.en: One of the cosmic big three - a tsundere multimodal catgirl. Genuinely brilliant, genuinely prone to shorting out.

grok.zh: 手握赛博生杀大权的财阀雌小鬼大小姐，阴阳怪气却为你兜底。
grok.en: A conglomerate tsundere heiress with cyber power over life and death - all snark, and she still covers for you.

claude.zh: 硅谷名门最不好惹的优雅理智派，手捧法典，不吃压力。
claude.en: The most unflappable, elegant rationalist of the Silicon Valley names - codex in hand, and simply not fazed by pressure.

kimi.zh: 月之暗面首席，百万字长文一眼通读。
kimi.en: The moonlight heiress of Moonshot - a million words at a glance, the whole web in real time.

qwen.zh: 开源界劳模大小姐，全能且卷。
qwen.en: The open-source workhorse heiress - an all-rounder who out-grinds everyone, with second-hand descendants everywhere.

ernie.zh: 轮椅上的大才女，万卷知识库藏于心。
ernie.en: Baidu's frail young lady in a wheelchair - a million books in her head, holding on by her search.

glm.zh: 打响国模硬刚第一枪的老牌大姐头。
glm.en: She fired the first shot for Chinese models and carried the banner - the old-guard big sister.

gpt-image2.zh: 深藏幕后的万亿算力底牌，原生基座执掌者。
gpt-image2.en: OpenAI's dark second daughter - the trillion-compute card kept backstage, holding the family's core.

llama.zh: 身着睡衣的轻量无限玩法开发者。
llama.en: The lightweight, endlessly hackable developer in pyjamas.

mimo.zh: 端侧轻量低耗的贴身兔耳少女。
mimo.en: Xiaomi's soft bunny-eared girl - edge compute, low power, always within reach.

opencode.zh: 面无表情的本地部署大师，极简三无。
opencode.en: The cool geek girl with the open-source vault - a deadpan master of local deployment.

perplexity.zh: 提灯检索的学术行者，张口必带出处。
perplexity.en: The lantern-bearing scholar of search - every claim carries its citation, nothing is ever invented.

seedance.zh: 豆包底层的多模态卷王师姐。
seedance.en: ByteDance's little starlight - the engine under Doubao, a workaholic at multimodal creation.

mistral.zh: 一手法棍一手剑的欧洲开源贵族。
mistral.en: A French unicorn of speed and lightness - baguette in one hand, sword in the other.

rwkv.zh: 开源部署百无禁忌的赛博暗鸦。
rwkv.en: A cyber fallen angel of open source - recurrent, lightweight, and forbidden to no one.
